summary: Plan interrogated against roadmap ACs, all active decisions (0000-0120), and the Codex read-only pipeline map. One AC found unimplementable as written (send_message destinations - no destination argument exists in the tool contract); resolved as satisfied-by-construction in plan+spec, flagged for human confirmation at approval. Single-seam shape confirmed simplest: host IPC tail guard only; worker matcher scope untouched.
gaps: Roadmap AC-3 requires denying send_message to 'other destinations', but the tool schema has no destination parameter (schemas.ts:75; registry injects run conversation) - the AC is unimplementable as written
New deterministic denial needs typed provenance per 0107 - plan must name the decidedBy value
Guard predicate could be spoofed if keyed on worker-supplied fields instead of host-verified run context
Reason-string attribution: worker local-miss text rides IPC and can masquerade as host rationale on allows (the confusing 'allowed + no-match reason' pairing)
The ~45 historical classifier-allowed RunCommand variants become denials post-cutover - potential user-facing pause burst
contradictions: 0043 classifier-risk-only-engine-authz: removing the classifier from the autonomous path must not contradict its charter - reconciled: 0043 governs WHAT the classifier judges (risk, not authz); this plan narrows WHERE it runs (interactive only); a new decision record amends the auto-mode contract explicitly
resolutions: AC-3: plan Non-goals + spec record own-conversation-only as the current contract; destination-bearing send_message is a named future public-contract decision; human confirmation requested at plan approval
Provenance: decidedBy=deterministic_rails for the new denial path, matching the existing unattended hard-floor cancellation vocabulary (0107)
Guard keys on the host-verified run-registry jobId (CAPRULE-1 host-stamp), never worker-supplied payload fields - pinned in plan Risks and to be pinned by unit test
Attribution fix in scope: host match reason becomes the recorded decisionReason on allows; worker text demoted to diagnostic context
Pause-burst trade accepted explicitly by Ravi in chat 2026-08-11 ('Remove entirely'); each variant is at most one grantable card then deterministic forever; noted in plan Risks
open_items: delivery-semantics recurring finding family is adjacent (send_message) but this plan changes authorization not delivery; closeout should confirm pause-card copy renders the truthful reason (non-blocking)
Decision number 0121 subject to origin/main collision check before push (known parallel-branch trap)
